## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (92%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated frozen section [F1] has flagged reliability; defer margins to permanents [F7] and consider recut or deeper levels.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 92%, InSitu 7%, Benign 1%, Normal 1% | Strong invasive score; test ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (10% alpha, 90% test coverage) | Single class at dataset-level guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 44% reliability (flagged), 100th percentile OOD [F6] | Suspect out-of-distribution input (AUROC 70%) |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree (same_top = false) | Independent foundation models disagree on top |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Invasive (40%), 3/5 InSitu [F5] | Split with InSitu reference neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 4, 5, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.64 contribution) pushing strongest toward invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.49 contribution); scarce tubules push toward invasive [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Typical-range score (+0.37 contribution), but failed 0/20 AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Low duct-confinement score (+0.33 contribution); separates case from InSitu contrast · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (+0.14 contribution), weak concept failing 0/20 spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (0.0114; 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); case leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Tumor is InSitu, matching 3/5 reference neighbors and contrast case BACH_0117 (80% similarity; differs in lobules and duct confinement).
- Severe resampling degradation (severity 3, 100th-percentile OOD) distorts morphology, explaining why CONCH and MUSK foundation models disagree.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 10**: Highest heatmap risk (100%); confirm true stromal invasion versus duct-confined InSitu carcinoma.
2. **Regions 4, 5, 9**: Verify marked nuclear pleomorphism (regions 4, 5) and stromal infiltration (region 9).
3. **Region 7**: Inspect tubules and lobules; defer frozen margins to permanents and consider recut or deeper levels.
